lines.japanese: 先週からの流れで、今朝は早起きすることが出来た。目覚ましを一つ増やしたのもよかったかもしれない。
lines.english: Riding last week's momentum, I managed to wake up early this morning. Adding another alarm clock might have helped.

lines.japanese: それでも臨時とはいえ、主婦業を一手に担う小鳩よりはゆっくり起きてるし、今も台所から聞こえる水流音を聞いてると、もう少し早起きした方がいんじゃね？　って気持ちになってくる。
lines.english: Even so, I still got up after Kobato, who was temporarily shouldering every bit of housework herself. Listening to the water running in the kitchen now, I found myself thinking, Maybe I oughta get up a little earlier.

lines.japanese: そうだ「なってくる」場合じゃないのだ。思いついたときに即、行動しなければ、生活に習慣づけることなど出来ないのだ。というわけで俺は、結びかけた靴紐を解いて玄関に背中を向けたのだ。
lines.english: Right. This was no time to ‘find myself thinking’ anything. Unless I acted the instant the thought occurred to me, I would never make a habit of it. And so I untied the shoelace I had nearly finished tying and turned my back on the front door.

lines.japanese: だが台所に向かう途中で、電話がかかってきてしまったのだ。
lines.english: On my way to the kitchen, however, the telephone rang.

lines.japanese: なんだよ、ひとがせっかくやる気出してたのに。俺は少しイラだった手で受話器をつかむと、荒っぽく持ちあげて大きく息を吸いこんだ。
lines.english: What the hell? I had finally worked up some motivation. I snatched up the receiver in mild irritation, jerked it to my ear, and drew a deep breath.

lines.japanese: <6>\「オドレ、ここが羽田組だと知って電話かけとンのかァ！　どこのモンじゃワレェ！」
lines.english: “YOU KNOW YOU'VE CALLED THE HANEDA SYNDICATE, YOU BASTARD! WHO THE HELL ARE YOU WITH!?”

lines.japanese: 「お兄さん。おはようございます、キッカワです」
lines.english: “Good morning. It’s Kikkawa.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩へのお兄ちゃん愛を邪魔されたので怒りをぶつけてみたが、あっさりと対応された。
lines.english: She had interrupted me just as I was about to shower Kobato with brotherly devotion, so I took it out on her. She handled me without missing a beat.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、またセールスのキッカワか。今日はなんの用だ」
lines.english: “Oh. Kicker the saleswoman again. What're you selling today?”

lines.japanese: 「あのぅ、私、セールスじゃないんです」
lines.english: “Um, I’m not a saleswoman.”

lines.japanese: 「黙れ、前回だってコーヒー豆を俺に売りつけようとしたじゃないか」
lines.english: “Silence! Last time you tried to sell me coffee beans.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ……もうそれでいいです……」
lines.english: “Sigh... Fine. Whatever you say...”
“Hm.”

lines.japanese: キッカワが拗ねたような声を出すので、ちょっと悪いことをした気分になってしまった。だがこれはやつらの常套手段、ここで甘い顔を見せてはタコ壺を買わされてしまう。
lines.english: Kicker's sulky voice made me feel a little guilty. But this was standard sales technique. Show the slightest weakness and she'd have me buying an octopus pot.

lines.japanese: 「こほん。それで、今日はどんなタコ壺のご紹介ですか？」
lines.english: “Ahem. And what sort of octopus pot are you offering today?”

lines.japanese: 俺はちょっとだけ態度を軟化させた。
lines.english: I softened my attitude by the smallest degree.

lines.japanese: 「あ、いえ、今日はタコ壺じゃないです」
lines.english: “Oh, no. Today it isn’t an octopus pot.”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ！　じゃあなんだ？　こここ小鳩には代わらないぞ！」
lines.english: “What!? Then what do you want? I-I'm not putting Kobato on!”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、羽田さんに用事があるわけでもないんです。まだ待ち合わせには時間あるし……」
lines.english: “No, I wasn't calling for Kobato either. There's still time before we're supposed to meet...”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　セールスでもないし小鳩にも用事がないなら、なんの電話なんだこれ」
lines.english: “Huh? If you're not selling anything and you don't need Kobato, then what is this phone call?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、え、ええ、えっと」
lines.english: “Oh, um... well...”

lines.japanese: 「タコ壺はいかがですか」
lines.english: “Would you care to purchase an octopus pot?”

lines.japanese: どうやら標的を俺に変更したらしい。ほほう、俺にセールスを仕掛けようとは面白いじゃないか、くくく。
lines.english: Apparently she had switched her target to me. Well, well. Trying to sell something to me? This ought to be entertaining. Heh heh.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあどんなタコ壺なんだ、説明してみろ」
lines.english: “Then describe the octopus pot.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい、これはお安くてお求めやすいので、大変お買い得となっておりまして……」
lines.english: “Y-yes. It's very affordable and easy to purchase, making it an excellent bargain...”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、お安いんだあ。買う気なんてさっぱりないけど、どのくらいお買い得なのかなあ？」
lines.english: “Oh, very affordable? I have absolutely no intention of buying it, but just how much of a bargain are we talking?”

lines.japanese: 「えーと、１００万円くらい……かな？」
lines.english: “Um... about one million yen?”

lines.japanese: <10>\「お安くねえよ」
lines.english: “That's not cheap!”

lines.japanese: 「で、ですよね」
lines.english: “N-no. I suppose not.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、うっかりセールスの電話にツッコミ入れちゃった。おまえ、ついつい構ってやりたくさせるのが上手いな」
lines.english: “Damn it, I went and heckled a sales call. You really know how to make a guy play along.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい、ありがとうございます」
lines.english: “Y-yes. Thank you.”

lines.japanese: しかも丁寧だ。セールスの仕事なんてやってなければ、まるで吉川さんみたいだなあ。
lines.english: And so polite, too. If she weren't a saleswoman, she'd be exactly like Yoshikawa.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、今度は私から聞きたいことがありまして」
lines.english: “Um, this time there’s something I’d like to ask you.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、言ってみろ」
lines.english: “What is it? Speak.”

lines.japanese: 「消費者のみなさまの意見を聞くためにアンケートをとりたいのですが」
lines.english: “I'd like to conduct a survey to gather the opinions of our consumers.”

lines.japanese: 「む、なかなか殊勝な心がけだな。答えられるものなら答えてやろう」
lines.english: “Hm. An admirable initiative. If it's something I can answer, answer it I shall.”

lines.japanese: 「わあ、うれしいです」
lines.english: “Oh, I’m so happy.”

lines.japanese: セールスの女は意外といいやつだった。俺は少し晴れ晴れしい気持ちになった。
lines.english: The saleswoman was surprisingly decent. My spirits brightened a little.

lines.japanese: 「お兄さんの憧れる女性のタイプを教えてください」
lines.english: “What kind of woman do you dream of?”

lines.japanese: 「妖艶な色香の漂う女豹のような女だ」
lines.english: “A woman like a panther, wreathed in sultry allure.”

lines.japanese: 「よ、よーえん？」
lines.english: “S-sultry?”

lines.japanese: 「私でもなれるでしょうか」
lines.english: “Could even I become one?”

lines.japanese: 「いや知らないけど、がんばれば近づくことは出来るんじゃないか。いいか、そもそも大人の女というのはな」
lines.english: “How should I know? Put in the effort and I guess you could get closer. Listen: fundamentally, a grown woman is—”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんいつまで電話してるの？　遅れちゃうよ」
lines.english: “Big Brother, how long are you going to stay on the phone? We’ll be late.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ～い」
lines.english: “Coming!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が台所から出てきたので、即刻電話を切った。くそ、キッカワのせいで小鳩のお手伝いが出来なかったじゃないか。
lines.english: Kobato came out of the kitchen, so I hung up immediately. Damn Kicker. Because of her, I never got to help Kobato.

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩と並んで出かけたが、我が妹は途中で吉川さんと待ち合わせをしているらしく別れてしまった。
lines.english: Kobato and I left together, but partway there she split off to meet Yoshikawa.

lines.japanese: 吉川さんによろしくとだけ伝えて、俺は一人で学校に向かった。そういえば最近、吉川さんと話してないなあ。
lines.english: I only asked her to give Yoshikawa my regards, then continued to school alone. Come to think of it, I hadn't spoken with Yoshikawa lately.

lines.japanese: ゆっくりと家を出てきてしまったので、ほぼぎりぎりの時間で教室に着いた。
lines.english: I had taken my sweet time leaving home, so I reached the classroom with almost no time to spare.

lines.japanese: だと言うのに、一時間目の準備をする前に千客万来だった。ダイジェスト版だとこんなカンジだ。
lines.english: And yet, before I could even prepare for first period, visitors came pouring in. The digest version went something like this.

lines.japanese: 「おはようアッパーカットくん」
lines.english: “Morning, Pacquiao.”

lines.japanese: 「てめえ、もう『ぱ』しか原型留めてねえだろ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。あとおはよう」
lines.english: “You asshole, ‘pa’ is the only piece of the original name left! I'll fucking kill you, asshole. And good morning.”

lines.japanese: 最初に話しかけてきたのはプリンセス。いつもはだるそうにしてるくせに、今日はやけに機嫌が良さそうだ。俺は鞄を開きながら、アイドルみたいな女の顔を見上げた。
lines.english: Princess was the first to approach me. She usually looked terminally bored, but today she was in an oddly good mood. I opened my bag and looked up at her face, pretty enough for an idol.

lines.japanese: 「ねえねえ昼休み、玉泉の様子見にいこうよ」
lines.english: “Hey, let’s go check on Tamaizumi at lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう、なんだ藪から肉棒に」
lines.english: “Well, well. Talk about a cock from the blue.”

lines.japanese: 「ぱね田くんは直接話せないだろうけど、二人でおちょくりに行こうぜ」
lines.english: “You can't talk to Tamaizumi directly, Paneda, but the two of us can go mess with her.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょちょ、待って渡来さん、ツッコミがないよ。肉棒だけにね」
lines.english: “W-wait, Watarai. You skipped the comeback! I said cock, see?”

lines.japanese: 「計画としてはこうだ。おそらくアルバイト先まで来られたくない玉泉は、クラスメイトに仕事のことを話してないと思うんだ。それをネタに強請ってあげよう」
lines.english: “Here's the plan. Tamaizumi probably hasn't told her classmates about her job because she doesn't want them showing up there. We'll use it to blackmail her.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえとんでもない上級生だな。ツンドラ気候で生まれた俺ですら寒気が走るわ」
lines.english: “You’re one hell of an upperclassman. I was born in the tundra, and even I just felt a chill.”

lines.japanese: 「で、どうなの。行くの、行かないの」
lines.english: “Well? Are you coming or not?”

lines.japanese: 「行くに決まってんだろう。拡声器持って遊びに行こうぜ」
lines.english: “Of course I'm coming. Let's take a megaphone.”

lines.japanese: 「よく言った。それでこそ私の恋人、デンプシーロールくんだ」
lines.english: “Well said. That's my boyfriend, Dempsey Roll.”

lines.japanese: 「とうとう『ぱ』すらなくなったのかよ。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。あと気安く恋人とか言うのやめてよ、見ろよ周りの連中が俺を恨めしそうに睨みつけていやがるぜびくびく」
lines.english: “Now even the ‘pa’ is gone! I'll fucking kill you, asshole. I'll fucking kill you, asshole. And quit calling me your boyfriend like it's nothing. Look around—the guys are glaring at me with murder in their eyes. *Shudder shudder.*”

lines.japanese: 「なに今さら言ってんの、私たち愛しあってるよね」
lines.english: “What are you talking about this late in the game? We love each other.”

lines.japanese: 「や、やかましいっ！　恐ろしい出任せを抜かすな！」
lines.english: “S-shut up! Don't go spouting terrifying bullshit!”

lines.japanese: 目に見えて教室内の空気が重くなった。比喩表現じゃない、少なくとも俺には本当に色が黒ずんだように見えたのだ。
lines.english: The air in the classroom visibly grew heavier. That wasn't a metaphor. To my eyes, at least, it literally darkened.

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、よく考えたらもうおまえなんかに気を使う必要なかったんだ。へへん、誰がおまえなんかと付きあうかぶ顔。ようし今ここでバラしてやる。いいかおまえら！　俺といま目の前にいる駄姫はなあっ！」
lines.english: “Wait. Come to think of it, I don't have to be considerate of you anymore. Hah! Like anybody'd date your ugly mug. All right, I'll tell them the truth right now. Listen up, people! This sorry excuse for a princess and I—”

lines.japanese: 「バラしたらおまえの疑惑もバラすぞ」
lines.english: “Tell them the truth, and I'll tell them what I suspect about you.”

lines.japanese: 「来る日も来る日も官能生活だ！　今朝もはよから、ずんずんぱんぱん！　ずんぱんぱん！」
lines.english: “Day after day, a life of carnal bliss! From the crack of dawn this morning, thrust-thrust, pound-pound! Thrust-pound-pound!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ラッシャァァァ！　ワラッシャァァァ！」
lines.english: “RASSHAAAA! WARASSHAAAA!”

lines.japanese: 「なあ知ってる？　太陽が熱いからって理由でひとを殺したやつがいたらしいぜ。今なら俺、刑法１９９条くらい軽くクリアできちゃう気がするんだよね」
lines.english: “Hey, hear about the guy who killed someone because the sun was hot? Right now, I feel like I could breeze straight through Article 199 myself.”

lines.japanese: 「つーかさあ、一人で殺したら犯罪でも、百人で殺せば民主的に許されるんじゃねえ？　俺もいま丁度その気分なんだよなあ」
lines.english: “I mean, sure, one person killing him would be a crime, but if a hundred people did it, wouldn't democracy make it legal? That's about where I'm at right now.”

lines.japanese: 「あーあ、早く夜になんねえかなあ。廊下で闇討ちできる時間が待ち遠しいぜ」
lines.english: “Man, when's it gonna get dark? I can't wait till the halls are dim enough for an ambush.”

lines.japanese: 「狙われた学園！」
lines.english: “*The School in the Crosshairs!*”

lines.japanese: ぐ、ぐうっ、しまった、渡来がバカだから忘れてたけど、プリンセスの支持率は俺の命の価値を上回るんだった。
lines.english: N-ngh! Damn it. Watarai was such an idiot that I had forgotten Princess's approval rating outweighed the value of my life.

lines.japanese: くそう、今日は放課後になったら速攻で帰ろう……俺は背中を丸めながら座席に着いた。
lines.english: Shit. The instant school ended, I was going straight home... Hunched over, I took my seat.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう、羽田君」
lines.english: “Good morning, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「おはよう、山科。今日もお店を覗いてみたんだけど、会えなかったな」
lines.english: “Morning, Yamashina. I looked into the shop again today, but I missed you.”

lines.japanese: 次に話しかけてきたのは煙草屋の娘。金曜日はやけにテンションが高かったけど、今日は落ちついてるみたいだ。俺は教科書を机にしまいながら、不安そうな女の顔を見上げた。
lines.english: Next came the tobacconist's daughter. Her energy had been through the roof on Friday, but today she seemed calm. I slid my textbook into the desk and looked up at her anxious face.

lines.japanese: 「あの、先週はゴメン。私、一人ではしゃいじゃって迷惑だったよね」
lines.english: “Um, sorry about last week. I got carried away all by myself. I must've been a nuisance.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　ああ、テンション高かったな。なんだ、夜に見たいアニメでもあったのか」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, you were pretty hyper. What, was there some anime you wanted to see that night?”

lines.japanese: 「もしそれで許してもらえるなら、そういうことにしておきたいな。うんそうだね、いい言い訳かも。今度使わせてもらうよ」
lines.english: “If that'll get me forgiven, I'd like to say yes. Actually, that's a pretty good excuse. I might use it next time.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 思いだして見ると、今の山科と比べて別人みたいだったな。まさか俺と同じ症状ってことはないよな。
lines.english: Thinking back, she had seemed like a completely different person from the Yamashina before me now. Surely she didn't have the same condition I did.

lines.japanese: なんにしても深く突っこまない方がいいのかもしれない。山科もなにか申し訳なさそうだし、別の話題になんとか切りかえたいけど……。
lines.english: Whatever the case, maybe it was better not to pry. Yamashina already looked guilty about something. I wanted to steer us onto another subject, but...

lines.japanese: つっても俺と山科と共通点なんて、アレしかないんだよな。
lines.english: Thing was, Yamashina and I only had one subject in common.

lines.japanese: 「まあ好きなバンドとか被るとテンションが上がるよな。インディーズだったらなおさらだろうし」
lines.english: “Well, finding out somebody likes the same band can get you pretty worked up. Especially when it's an indie band.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん。それも原因の一端ではあるかな」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. That was part of it.”

lines.japanese: 「またそのうち、受験が終わったら帰りにでも話そう」
lines.english: “We'll talk again sometime after entrance exams. Maybe on the way home.”

lines.japanese: うん、これで綺麗にまとまっただろう。めでたしめでたし。
lines.english: There. Wrapped up nice and neat. And they all lived happily ever after.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ファンのひとと話したい？　だったらファンサイトもあるけど、教えてあげようか」
lines.english: “Oh, do you want to talk to some other fans? There's a fan site. Want me to show you?”

lines.japanese: 「あん？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: と思ったら、話がヘンな方向に流れはじめた。山科が確かめるような視線で俺を見上げてる。
lines.english: Or so I thought, until the conversation veered in a strange direction. Yamashina looked up at me as if checking my reaction.

lines.japanese: 「いやそこまではいい……あいや、ちょっと待て」
lines.english: “No, I don't need to go that far... Wait. Hold on.”

lines.japanese: ロックバードのファンサイト……どこかで聞いたことあるような……ていうか前に掲示板とかライブハウスとか言ってたな。
lines.english: A Rockbird fan site... Where had I heard something like that...? Come to think of it, she had mentioned message boards and small music venues before.

lines.japanese: 「山科……もしかしてＲ－ウイングって知って……」
lines.english: “Yamashina... You wouldn't happen to know R-Wing, would you...?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、知ってるんだ？　もしかして、一緒に集まったりしてる？」
lines.english: “Oh, you know them? Do you ever go to their meetups?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……全然……」
lines.english: “No... Not at all...”

lines.japanese: 「私も一緒にライブ行ったりしたことはないんだけど、友達が何人かいるんだ」
lines.english: “I've never gone to a show with them, but I do have several friends in the group.”

lines.japanese: そうか、山科も知ってたのか……。
lines.english: So Yamashina knew them too...

lines.japanese: 「もし羽田君にも知り合いがいるなら、今度オフ会でもやる？」
lines.english: “If you know some of them too, maybe we could have a fan meetup sometime?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、いい……」
lines.english: “No, thanks...”

lines.japanese: お腹が痛くなりそうだった。
lines.english: I could feel a stomachache coming on.

lines.japanese: 「おはよー、羽田」
lines.english: “Morning, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、副委員長。朝から話しかけてくるとは珍しいな」
lines.english: “Oh, Deputy Chairwoman. It’s rare for you to speak to me this early.”

lines.japanese: 三人目は副委員長だった。そうだ、俺も言っておくことがあったし丁度いい。俺は対人用の微笑みを浮かべつつ、厚化粧が施された女の顔を見上げた。
lines.english: My third visitor was the deputy chairwoman. Good—I had something to tell her too. Wearing my public-facing smile, I looked up at her heavily made-up face.

lines.japanese: 「あー……あのさ」
lines.english: “Uh... Listen.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ分かってる、卒文制作だろう。優秀な班員たちがよく働いてくれたおかげで先週中に終わったぞ」
lines.english: “I know. The graduation anthology, right? Thanks to the tireless efforts of my outstanding teammates, we finished it last week.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そー」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「え、それだけ？」
lines.english: “What, that’s all?”

lines.japanese: 少しくらい労ってくれてもいいのに、相変わらずだなこいつは。ふう。
lines.english: A little appreciation wouldn’t have killed her. But that was her all over. Sigh.

lines.japanese: まあ確かにクラスの作業だからな、終わらせるのが当然っちゃ当然か。別に誉められるようなことじゃない。
lines.english: Then again, it was the whole class's job. Of course we finished it. Nothing especially praiseworthy there.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、そゆことで」
lines.english: “Well, that’s that.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、つーか……」
lines.english: “No, wait. I mean...”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　まだなにかあるのか？」
lines.english: “Hm? Is there something else?”

lines.japanese: 「だから……」
lines.english: “It’s just...”

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうした、やけに歯切れが悪いじゃないか。具合が悪いなら、俺じゃなくてしかるべき性病科に行った方がいいぞ」
lines.english: “Wh-what's wrong? You're unusually tongue-tied. If you're feeling sick, you should probably see an STD clinic instead of me.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そーゆーんじゃなくて」
lines.english: “No, it isn’t that.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうか、脳外科の方か」
lines.english: “I-I see. Neurosurgery, then.”

lines.japanese: 副委員長は一度口をつぐんで、目を窓の外に向けた。
lines.english: The deputy class rep closed her mouth and looked out the window.

lines.japanese: そしてすぐ俺に視線を戻して唇を解く。
lines.english: Then she looked back at me and opened her mouth again.

lines.japanese: 「あのさ今日私、白着けて……」
lines.english: “Listen. Today I'm wearing white...”

lines.japanese: そこまで言いかけて、また視線を逸らしてしまった。
lines.english: Halfway through the sentence, she looked away again.

lines.japanese: 「ゴメン、やっぱいい」
lines.english: “Sorry. Never mind.”

lines.japanese: なんだったんだろう……気にはなるけど、深入りはしたくないのであえて何も聞かないことにした。
lines.english: What had that been about...? I was curious, but I had no desire to get deeply involved, so I deliberately asked nothing.

lines.japanese: 早く授業始まらないかなあ……。
lines.english: Would class please start already...?

lines.japanese: さて昼休み。渡来と一緒に二年生の階に来たんだが……
lines.english: And now it was lunchtime. Watarai and I had come to the second-year floor, but...

lines.japanese: この女といっしょに歩いてると目立つ。今さらだけど人気あるんだなこいつ。
lines.english: Walking beside this woman drew stares. A little late to notice, but she really was popular.

lines.japanese: 「おっ、着いた。ここだよ玉泉の教室……」
lines.english: “Here we are. This is Tamaizumi’s class...”

lines.japanese: 「どしたの」
lines.english: “What’s wrong?”

lines.japanese: はっ。
lines.english: Ah.

lines.japanese: しまった、一瞬とはいえ渡来のことを考えてぼうっとしてしまった。
lines.english: Damn. For one brief moment, I had zoned out thinking about Watarai.

lines.japanese: 「何も知らない連中があまりに哀れで、くっ、くっ……」
lines.english: “Those poor fools who don't know the truth... Heh... heh...”

lines.japanese: 「なに突然。ワケ分かんない」
lines.english: “Where did that come from? I have no idea what you’re talking about.”

lines.japanese: 「いや悪い、じゃあさっそく玉泉の教室に入ろう」
lines.english: “Sorry. Let’s go into Tamaizumi’s classroom.”

lines.japanese: 「でもぱね田は玉泉と話せないんだっけ。じゃあ廊下に呼びださない方がいいか……仕方ない、優しい先輩のふりをして教室に乗りこんでくるよ」
lines.english: “But Paneda can't talk to Tamaizumi, can he? Then perhaps we shouldn't call her into the hall... No choice. I'll pretend to be a kind upperclassman and march into her classroom.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえいつか友達なくすぞ」
lines.english: “One day, you’ll lose every friend you have.”

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫だよ、私最初から友達少ないもんね」
lines.english: “I'll be fine. I didn't have many friends to begin with.”

lines.japanese: 「相手に求められることは多いくせに、ヘンなやつ」
lines.english: “Everybody wants something from you, yet you’re such a weirdo.”

lines.japanese: 「ヘンなやつって、それ誉め言葉だよ。ありがと」
lines.english: “Strange? That's a compliment. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 渡来は上機嫌で玉泉の教室に入っていった。ほんとヘンなやつ。
lines.english: In high spirits, Watarai entered Tamaizumi's classroom. What a strange woman.

lines.japanese: あんなのにとり憑かれて玉泉もかわいそうに。
lines.english: Poor Tamaizumi, haunted by a creature like that.

lines.japanese: ん？
lines.english: Hm?

lines.japanese: あ、玉泉のひと制服姿だ。アレキサンダーの制服もいいけど、これはこれでまた……。
lines.english: Oh. Tamaizumi was in her school uniform. Her Alexander uniform was nice, but this had its own...

lines.japanese: 「こんにちは、玉泉さん。相変わらず綺麗なおみ脚ね」
lines.english: “Good afternoon, Tamaizumi. Your lovely legs are as exquisite as ever.”

lines.japanese: 「帰ってください」
lines.english: “Please leave.”

lines.japanese: おっと、玉泉の脚なんかどうでもいいけどね。俺にはかわいい妹がいるから見とれてなんかないよ、うん。
lines.english: Not that Tamaizumi's legs mattered. I had an adorable little sister, so obviously I wasn't staring. Right.

lines.japanese: いや、見とれた方が健全なの……か？
lines.english: Wait. Would staring have been healthier...?

lines.japanese: 「玉泉さんとお話したくて遊びに来たの。お邪魔だった？」
lines.english: “I came because I wanted to talk to you. Am I intruding?”

lines.japanese: 「はい、とても」
lines.english: “Yes. Very much so.”

lines.japanese: あの上級生をも恐れない態度はまさしく玉泉日和子。うん、それは間違いない。
lines.english: That attitude, fearless even before an upperclassman, was unmistakably Hiyoko Tamaizumi. Yes. No question there.

lines.japanese: でも学校の制服を着てるだけで、こんなに新鮮味を感じるのか……いや別に今さら特別な感想があるわけじゃない……けど……。
lines.english: But could a school uniform alone really make her seem this fresh...? Not that I had any special thoughts about her after all this time... although...

lines.japanese: と思いつつも、普段見られないありがたさも加わって、勝手に引きつけられる俺の眼球。ああ綺麗だなあ、玉泉の脚。
lines.english: Even as I thought that, the rarity of the sight drew my eyes of their own accord. Ah. Tamaizumi's legs were beautiful.

lines.japanese: 「ほほう、今の私にそんな口を利いていいのかい玉泉。うふふ」
lines.english: “Well, well. Are you sure you can afford to take that tone with me now, Tamaizumi? Ohoho.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、なにか問題でも」
lines.english: “I see. Is there some problem?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、おなか空いたなあ～。今日の放課後、レストランにでも寄って帰ろうかなあ」
lines.english: “Ahh, I'm hungry. Maybe I'll stop by a restaurant after school today.”

lines.japanese: ああ、玉泉の顔が苦々しくなっていく。そして優しく後輩の手をとるプリンセス。
lines.english: Ah, Tamaizumi's face was tightening in bitterness. And Princess gently took her junior by the hand.

lines.japanese: 「いまお腹にいっぱい詰めておけば、放課後は寄り道しないで帰れるかもしれない」
lines.english: “If I fill my stomach now, maybe I'll be able to go straight home after school without stopping anywhere.”

lines.japanese: 「……パンですか米ですか」
lines.english: “...Bread or rice?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、買ってくれるの？　なんだか悪いね、ごちそうになっちゃって」
lines.english: “What, you're buying? Gosh, I feel bad, letting you treat me.”

lines.japanese: 「いいええ、渡来先輩には普段からお世話になっていますから、ほんのお礼の気持ちです」
lines.english: “Oh, not at all. You’re always so good to me, Watarai. Think of it as a little thank-you.”

lines.japanese: 顔と声は笑ったままに、目だけで怒りを表す器用な表情を浮かべながら玉泉は立ちあがった。
lines.english: Tamaizumi rose with a remarkably skillful expression: her face and voice kept smiling while her eyes alone burned with rage.

lines.japanese: 渡来は手を後ろに組みながら実に乙女らしい仕草でついていく。それがまた様になっていて、玉泉の神経を逆なでしてるだろうことは、想像に難くなかった。
lines.english: Watarai followed with her hands clasped behind her back, every inch the demure young lady. It looked perfectly natural on her, which could only be grating further on Tamaizumi's nerves.

lines.japanese: 「いやー、おいしいねえこのアンパン。ほら遠慮せずに玉泉も食べなよ」
lines.english: “Mmm, this red-bean bun is delicious. Come on, Tamaizumi, don't be shy. Have some.”

lines.japanese: 「いいええ、食餌療法を実践中ですからお気になさらず召しあがってください」
lines.english: “Nooo, thank you. I am undergoing dietary therapy. Please enjoy it without troubling yourself over me.”

lines.japanese: 地味に目立ってる。
lines.english: They were attracting a surprising amount of attention.

lines.japanese: 傍目には穏やかに会話する二人の女生徒は、男子の視線を集めまくっていた。
lines.english: To an observer, the two schoolgirls were having a perfectly peaceful conversation. Every boy in sight was staring.

lines.japanese: 渡来は俺を同行させたかったみたいだが、よかった一緒に行かなくて。渡来一人でも大変なのに、両手に花とでも思われたら速攻で闇討ちだ。
lines.english: Watarai had apparently wanted me to go with them, but thank God I hadn't. Watarai alone was dangerous enough. If anybody thought I had a beauty on each arm, I'd be ambushed on the spot.

lines.japanese: 同席したらどんな会話が繰り広げられたのか、興味はある。だから一応、こうして観察を続けているわけだ。
lines.english: I was curious what kind of conversation would have unfolded if I joined them. That was why I kept watching from there. Purely for research.

lines.japanese: 「玉泉さあ」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes?”

lines.japanese: 「友達少ないよね？」
lines.english: “You don't have many friends, do you?”

lines.japanese: 「あの、それに私が答えたとして、なにか発展性のある会話に繋がるんでしょうか。先輩の意図を計りかねます」
lines.english: “And if I answer, will that lead anywhere productive? I fail to see what you're after.”

lines.japanese: 「玉泉をおちょくりたい」
lines.english: “I want to mess with you.”

lines.japanese: 「どうして私なんですか。他の人でやってください」
lines.english: “Why me? Please do it to someone else.”

lines.japanese: 「私、友達いないからなあ」
lines.english: “I haven't got any friends, you see.”

lines.japanese: 「知りません。自己責任です」
lines.english: “That is none of my concern. You have only yourself to blame.”

lines.japanese: 「……は？　いまなんと？」
lines.english: “...What? What did you just say?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ玉泉、恋バナしようぜ」
lines.english: “Oh, I know, Tamaizumi. Let's talk about boys.”

lines.japanese: 「渡来先輩には会話をするつもりがないんですか？」
lines.english: “Do you have no intention whatsoever of holding a conversation?”

lines.japanese: 「玉泉さあ、好きなひといる？」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, is there anybody you like?”

lines.japanese: 「知りませ……な、なんですかいきなり」
lines.english: “I don't kn—w-what is this, all of a sudden?”

lines.japanese: 玉泉が体を引いた。その分だけ渡来が詰めよった。
lines.english: Tamaizumi leaned away. Watarai closed the distance by exactly the same amount.

lines.japanese: 「例えばアルバイト先に素敵な男の子が入ってきたりとかさあ」
lines.english: “Like, say, a nice guy started working at your part-time job?”

lines.japanese: しかもなにを聞こうとしてやがる。よせ止めろ。
lines.english: And what the hell did she think she was asking? Stop. Don't.

lines.japanese: と言いたいが、今の俺には渡来を止める手段がなかった。
lines.english: That's what I wanted to say, but I had no way to stop Watarai right now.

lines.japanese: 「ありません」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: しかしありがたいことに玉泉はきっぱり否定した。しょぼーん。
lines.english: Thankfully, Tamaizumi denied it flatly. Aw...

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ恋愛対象になりうるひとは？」
lines.english: “Then is there anybody who could become a romantic prospect?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、いません」
lines.english: “No. There isn’t.”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、今の間はなんだ、いるのか」
lines.english: “Oh-ho! What was that pause? There is somebody!”

lines.japanese: 「いないと言いました」
lines.english: “I said there is not.”

lines.japanese: 「玉泉さあ、私に恋人がいるの知ってたっけ」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, did you know I have a boyfriend?”

lines.japanese: 「……はあ。噂くらいは」
lines.english: “...Yes. I've heard the rumors.”

lines.japanese: 「最近会ってなくてさあ」
lines.english: “I haven’t seen him lately.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「今度会ったらデートしようと思うんだよね」
lines.english: “I'm thinking we'll go on a date the next time I see him.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ……え、ご自由にされればいいじゃないですか」
lines.english: “I see... Well, then do as you please.”

lines.japanese: 「さっきも言ったじゃん、最近会ってないんだよ」
lines.english: “I just told you. I haven't seen him lately.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、じゃあ会えば……」
lines.english: “Then go see him...”

lines.japanese: 「しばらく会えなそうなんだよね」
lines.english: “Looks like I won't be able to for a while.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんですか？」
lines.english: “Is that so?”

lines.japanese: 玉泉が目を逸らして数秒だけ黙った。なにか考えてたみたいだ。
lines.english: Tamaizumi looked away and fell silent for several seconds. Apparently she was thinking about something.

lines.japanese: 「そんなに好きなんですか？　私にはよく分かりません」
lines.english: “Do you really love him that much? I don't understand.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、私もよく分かってないんだよね」
lines.english: “Ahaha. I don't really understand either.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「すぐ逃げちゃうからね。次に会ったら言いたいことがいっぱいあるんだ」
lines.english: “He runs off right away, you know. I’ve got so much I want to tell him the next time I see him.”

lines.japanese: 「怖い女みたいですね」
lines.english: “You sound like a terrifying woman.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “The hell you say.”

lines.japanese: 「ただ」
lines.english: “However...”

lines.japanese: 玉泉が初めて笑いらしい表情を顔に浮かべた。な、なんだ、話の内容はともかく、制服でそんな顔されると、かわいいと思ってしまうじゃないか……。
lines.english: For the first time, something like a smile appeared on Tamaizumi's face. Wh-what? Subject matter aside, if she made that face in her school uniform, I was going to think she was kind of cute...

lines.japanese: 「いますね。すぐに逃げだすひと」
lines.english: “There is someone like that. Somebody who runs away immediately.”

lines.japanese: しまうじゃ、ないか……。
lines.english: ...I really was going to think she was cute.

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ、頭に浮かんだひとがいたので、次に会ったら逃げ道をふさいで注意することにします」
lines.english: “Hee hee. Somebody came to mind. Next time I see him, I'll block off his escape and give him a proper talking-to.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、玉泉、そいつやっちゃえよ」
lines.english: “Oh-ho! Tamaizumi, you go get him.”

lines.japanese: 「やっちゃいません。一度きちんと言わせてもらうだけのことです」
lines.english: “I will do no such thing. I will merely tell him what needs to be said, properly and once.”

lines.japanese: あ、あわわわわ……なんだ、なんて恐ろしい会話をしてるんだ。
lines.english: W-w-wait... What kind of terrifying conversation was this?

lines.japanese: 俺は前かがみになりながら渡来に見えないようこそこそと食堂から逃げだした。
lines.english: Keeping myself bent low so Watarai wouldn't spot me, I crept out of the cafeteria.

lines.japanese: 「いや、いいね玉泉。お昼に誘った甲斐があるよ」
lines.english: “This is great, Tamaizumi. I’m so glad I invited you to lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「誘われてません。強制的に連行されたんです」
lines.english: “You did not invite me. You dragged me here by force.”

lines.japanese: 「玉泉さあ、私が恋敵になったらどうする？」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, what would you do if I became your rival in love?”

lines.japanese: 「タチの悪い絡み方をしないでください。私は恋をしたことがないので分かりません」
lines.english: “Please stop pestering me in such an obnoxious way. I have never fallen in love, so I cannot say.”

lines.japanese: 「そもそも私が渡来先輩と同じひとを好きになるとは思えません」
lines.english: “To begin with, I cannot imagine falling for the same person as you, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふん、若いねえ玉泉」
lines.english: “Heh. You're so young, Tamaizumi.”

lines.japanese: だから二人の会話は最後まで聞こえなかった。そう、なにも聞こえなかった。
lines.english: And so I did not hear the rest of their conversation. Correct. I heard absolutely nothing.
